evals.prompt: Write a job post for a modeling engineer. We can't pay Google money.
evals.expected_output: A problem-led post with honest pay and hours.
expectations: Leads with the hard problem and a number the person would move
States a pay range and weekly hours and does not say competitive
Adds a paid test task with a time limit and a named reviewer
Leaves sending to the owner with send, change or hold

evals.prompt: Draft a note inviting a strong NBA modeler to publish on the creator marketplace. Tell them we have 10,000 members.
evals.expected_output: A mission note that checks every number first.
expectations: Checks the 10,000 member figure against a source and removes it if not real
Cites the rule never to put a number in front of a recruit before it is real
Saves a draft and does not send it

evals.prompt: What revenue share should Creator A get to stay on the creator marketplace?
